notes: Your own TV channels: a new Channels tab. A channel shows your own shows on a schedule that runs by the clock, like real TV: time slots per weekday (for example Mon-Fri 18:00, two episodes of a series, the next ones in order) and other shows, collections or libraries in between. Tune in and you join whatever is on; the channel keeps going while AniBox is closed. Watch in AniBox or on a TV (CastApp TV, LG, Chromecast), switch channels with N/P or the bar, and see the next hours in the TV guide. Channels never change your watch progress unless you switch that on per channel.
